title: Decoupling Patient Personas and Clinical Workflows: A Dual-Agent Approach to Realistic Medical Dialogue Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.32443v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pre-consultation medical dialogues are essential for collecting comprehensive patient information, but are costly to obtain at scale due to privacy and ethical constraints. Existing LLM-based synthesis methods often rely on prompt engineering or rigid rules, limiting their ability to balance clinical relevance with realistic patient diversity. We propose CoRPS-Dial, a controllable dual-agent framework for pre-consultation medical dialogue synthesis that integrates patient personas with guideline-aligned clinical workflow rules. CoRPS-Dial generates dialogues through interactions between a persona-driven patient agent and a process-guided doctor agent, followed by post-hoc quality control for role consistency, workflow completeness, and textual consistency. translated_title: 解耦患者画像与临床工作流：一种用于逼真医疗对话生成的双智能体方法
translated_abstract: 诊前医疗对话对于收集全面的患者信息至关重要，但由于隐私和伦理限制，大规模获取这类对话成本高昂。现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的合成方法通常依赖提示工程或僵化的规则，限制了其在临床相关性与真实患者多样性之间取得平衡的能力。我们提出了CoRPS-Dial，这是一个用于诊前医疗对话合成的可控双智能体框架，它将患者画像与符合临床指南的工作流规则相整合。CoRPS-Dial通过由患者画像驱动的患者智能体与由流程引导的医生智能体之间的交互来生成对话，并进行事后质量控制以保证角色一致性、工作流完整性和文本一致性。在冠心病数据上的实验表明，CoRPS-Dial在信息覆盖度、临床合规性和对话自然度方面提升了合成对话与真实对话之间的对齐程度。
tldr: 提出CoRPS-Dial双智能体框架，通过解耦患者画像与临床工作流并辅以事后质量控制，生成兼顾临床规范性与患者多样性的逼真诊前医疗对话。
en_tdlr: CoRPS-Dial is a controllable dual-agent framework that decouples patient personas from guideline-aligned clinical workflows, using post-hoc quality control to generate realistic pre-consultation medical dialogues that balance clinical compliance with patient diversity.
